decisive_items: An MRI of the hips and pelvis then demonstrated bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement and a left-sided insertional tendinopathy
response.rationale: MRI findings directly localize pathology to iliopsoas insertion, matching progressive hip weakness and pain; other candidates lack supportive imaging or are excluded.

rejected.why: Colchicine trial was presumptive and symptoms persisted; no crystal confirmation.
Narrower label, but MRI also shows muscle oedema; R5 is more complete.
No typical RA features; joint effusion nonspecific.
No crystal evidence; MRI not consistent with gouty arthropathy.
Less specific than tendinopathy; MRI shows insertional tendinopathy.
Bilateral muscle oedema could fit, but insertional tendinopathy and lack of classic PMR features favor R5.
